sets.relationshipLabel: the place in the shop and the item kept there
sets.explanation: A watch belongs in the display case just as a wrench belongs in the tool bin — each item has its designated spot.

sets.relationshipLabel: a worker and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: A pawnbroker inspects with a loupe just as a jeweler weighs with a scale — each trade has its defining tool.

sets.relationshipLabel: the two ends of a repeating cycle
sets.explanation: A pawned item is eventually redeemed just as a shop that opens each day eventually closes — both name the two ends of a cycle that repeats.

sets.relationshipLabel: a partial, deferred form and the full faculty it falls short of
sets.explanation: Layaway is a stand-in for real ownership just as an IOU is a stand-in for real payment — each names a promise that hasn't yet become the thing itself.
